User.description: A user in the TeamDynamix People database. Any type of field that is a collection, such as Attributes and Permissions, is only returned when a single user is selected. To increase performance, these collection fields are excluded from the data returned by endpoints such as api/people/search and api/people/lookup.

AboutMe.description: The "About Me" information associated with the user.

AlertEmail.description:
The alert email address of the user where system notifications are delivered.

Remarks: When not provided, the primary email is used.

AlternateEmail.description: The alternate email address of the user.

AlternateID.description: The alternate ID of the user.

Applications.description: The system-defined (non-platform) applications associated with the user.

ApplyTechnicianSignatureToReplies.description: Determines whether the technician signature associated with the user is applied to the replies for all tickets and ticket tasks.

ApplyTechnicianSignatureToUpdatesAndComm.description: Determines whether the technician signature associated with the user is applied to the updates and comments for all tickets and ticket tasks.

Attributes.description: The custom attributes associated with the user.

AuthenticationProviderID.description:
The ID of the authentication provider the new user will use for authentication. Value: The ID of the authentication provider the new user will use for authentication, or null to use TeamDynamix or SSO authentication.

Remarks: This value can be obtained from the Admin application Authentication section by one of your organization's administrators who has access to modify authentication settings. If an invalid value is provided, the default authentication provider for the organization will be used. This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to null.

AuthenticationUserName.description:
The authentication username of the user, used for authenticating with non-TeamDynamix authentication types. Value: The authentication username of the user.

Remarks: This value should be unique across all username and authentication usernames in your organization. If the provided value is not unique, it will be ignored. This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty string.

BEID.description: The UID of the organization associated with the user.

BEIDInt.description: The integer ID of the organization associated with the user.

CostRate.description:
The cost rate of the user. Value: The cost rate of the user, or 0.0 if the user is not of type User.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to 0.0.

DefaultAccountID.description: The ID of the default account/department associated with the user.

DefaultAccountName.description: The name of the default account/department associated with the user.

DefaultPriorityID.description: The ID of the default priority associated with the user.

DefaultPriorityName.description: The name of the default priority associated with the user.

DefaultRate.description:
The default bill rate of the user. Value: The default bill rate of the user, or 0.0 if the user is not of type User.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to 0.0.

DroppedCustomAttributeIds.description:
The IDs of any custom attributes that were supplied on create, edit, or patch but could not be saved
because they do not exist for this user or are protected attributes that cannot be written via
the API. Only populated on create, edit, and patch responses; null on reads.

EmailSuppressedDateUtc.description:
Gets or sets the date (UTC) when email suppression was applied to this user. Value: The UTC date of suppression, or null if not suppressed.

Remarks: This is a system-managed field and cannot be set via the API.

EndDate.description:
The date after which the user is no longer available for scheduling and no longer required to log time.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty date.

ExternalID.description: The organizational ID of the user.

Fax.description: The fax number of the user.

FirstName.description: The first name of the user.

FullName.description: The full name of the user.

GroupIDs.description:
The IDs of the groups associated with the user.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty list.

HomeAddress.description: The home address of the user.

HomeCity.description: The home city of the user.

HomeCountry.description: The home country of the user.

HomePhone.description: The home phone number of the user.

HomeState.description: The home state/province of the user.

HomeZip.description: The home postal code of the user.

IMHandle.description: The Instant Messenger (IM) username/handle associated with the user.

IMProvider.description: The Instant Messenger (IM) provider associated with the user.

IsActive.description: The active status of the user. Value: true if the user is active; otherwise, false.

IsAutomaticTicketAssignmentEnabled.description:
Gets or sets whether the user is enabled for automatic ticket assignment. Value: true if the user can be automatically assigned tickets; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This is a global opt-out flag that controls participation across all groups and applications. Defaults to true (users must explicitly opt out). For a user to be assigned via automatic assignment, all of the following must be true: 1. IsAutomaticTicketAssignmentEnabled = true (this flag) 2. User is included in the group's member list (not excluded) 3. User has access to the ticketing application

IsCapacityManaged.description:
Whether the user's capacity is managed, meaning they can have capacity and will appear on capacity/availability reports. Value: true if the user's capacity is managed; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to false.

IsConfidential.description:
The confidential status of the user. Value: true if the user is confidential; otherwise, false.

Remarks: Confidential users cannot be seen by unprivileged individuals within a client portal application.

IsEmailSuppressed.description:
Gets or sets whether email sending to this user has been suppressed due to bounces. Value: true if email is suppressed for this user; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This is a system-managed field and cannot be set via the API.

IsEmployee.description:
The employee status of the user. Value: true if the user is an employee; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to false.

LastName.description: The last name of the user.

LocationID.description: The ID of the location associated with the user.

LocationName.description: The name of the location associated with the user.

LocationRoomID.description: The ID of the location room associated with the user.

LocationRoomName.description: The name of the location room associated with the user.

LongDateFormatID.description:
The ID of the long-date format associated with the user. Supply `0` to inherit the
organization's format. Nullable on input — omit it to leave the user's current selection
unchanged when editing.
            
Valid values:
            
- `0` = Use organization format
- `1` = `ddd M/d/yyyy` (e.g. Tue 4/7/2026)
- `2` = `ddd d/M/yyyy` (e.g. Tue 7/4/2026)
- `3` = `ddd yyyy-MM-dd` (e.g. Tue 2026-04-07)
- `4` = `ddd d-MMM-yyyy` (e.g. Tue 7-Apr-2026)
- `5` = `ddd M/d/yy` (e.g. Tue 4/7/26)
- `6` = `ddd d/M/yy` (e.g. Tue 7/4/26)
- `7` = `ddd d-MMM-yy` (e.g. Tue 7-Apr-26)

LongDateFormatLabel.description: The display label (format pattern) of the long-date format associated with the user.

MiddleName.description: The middle name of the user.

MobilePhone.description: The mobile phone number of the user.

OrgApplications.description:
The organizationally-defined (platform) applications associated with the user.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty list.

OtherPhone.description: The other phone number of the user.

Pager.description: The pager number of the user.

Permissions.description:
The global security role permissions associated with the user.

Remarks: Each value refers to the ID of a permission. This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty list.

PrimaryClientPortalApplicationID.description:
The ID of the primary client portal application associated with the user. Value: The ID of the primary client portal application associated with the user, or null when the organization default client portal is used.

Remarks: This only applies to Users and will be ignored when creating Customers.

PrimaryEmail.description: The primary email address of the user.

PrimaryPhone.description:
The primary phone number of the user.

Remarks: Recognized values are:

  • Work
  • Home
  • Pager
  • Mobile
  • Other
  • Fax

Values outside of this set are equivalent to specifying the work phone.

ProfileImageFileName.description: The profile image file name of the user.

ReferenceID.description: The integer ID of the user.

ReportsToFullName.description: The full name of the person who the user reports to.

ReportsToUID.description: The UID of the person who the user reports to.

ReportTimeAfterDate.description:
The date after which the user should start reporting time. This also governs capacity calculations.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty date.

ResourcePoolID.description:
The ID of the resource pool associated with the user. Value: The ID of the resource pool associated with the user, or -1 if the user is not of type User.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to -1.

ResourcePoolName.description: The name of the resource pool associated with the user.

SecurityRoleID.description:
The UID of the global security role associated with the user. Value: The UID of the global security role associated with the user, or an empty string if the type is not User.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty string.

SecurityRoleName.description: The name of the global security role associated with the user.

ShortDateFormatID.description:
The ID of the short-date format associated with the user. Supply `0` to inherit the
organization's format. Nullable on input — omit it to leave the user's current selection
unchanged when editing.
            
Valid values:
            
- `0` = Use organization format
- `1` = `M/d/yyyy` (e.g. 4/7/2026)
- `2` = `d/M/yyyy` (e.g. 7/4/2026)
- `3` = `yyyy-MM-dd` (e.g. 2026-04-07)
- `4` = `d-MMM-yyyy` (e.g. 7-Apr-2026)

ShortDateFormatLabel.description: The display label (format pattern) of the short-date format associated with the user.

ShouldReportTime.description:
Whether the user should report time. Value: true if the user should report time; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to false.

TechnicianSignature.description: The technician signature associated with the user.

TimeFormatID.description:
The ID of the time format associated with the user. Supply `0` to inherit the organization's
format. Nullable on input — omit it to leave the user's current selection unchanged
when editing.
            
Valid values:
            
- `0` = Use organization format
- `1` = `h:mm tt` (e.g. 8:02 PM)
- `2` = `HH:mm` (e.g. 20:02)

TimeFormatLabel.description: The display label (format pattern) of the time format associated with the user.

TZID.description: The ID of the time zone associated with the user. Value: The ID of the time zone associated with the user, or 0 to use the time zone specified for the organization.

TZName.description: The name of the time zone associated with the user.

WorkableHours.description:
The number of workable hours in a work day for the user. Value: The number of workable hours in a work day for the user, or 0.0 if the user is not of type User.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to 0.0.

WorkAddress.description: The work address of the user.

WorkCity.description: The work city of the user.

WorkCountry.description: The work country of the user.

WorkPhone.description: The work phone number of the user.

WorkState.description: The work state/province of the user.

WorkZip.description: The work postal code of the user.

UserAccountsBulkManagementParameters.description:
A set of parameters designed to allow for setting the membership of
users in accounts.

AccountIDs.description: The IDs of the accounts to add to the users provided in UserUids.

ReplaceExistingAccounts.description: Whether accounts already granted to users that aren't in AccountIDs should be removed. Value: true if accounts already granted to users that aren't in AccountIDs should be removed; otherwise, false.

UserUids.description: The UIDs of the users to add the accounts provided in AccountIDs.

allOf.description: An association that a user has with an application.

SecurityRoleId.description: The ID of the security role that the user has within the application.

SecurityRoleName.description: The name of the security role that the user has within the application.

IsAdministrator.description: The administrator status of the user for the application.

UserApplicationsBulkManagementParameters.description:
A set of parameters designed to allow for setting the membership of
users in system-defined applications.

ApplicationNames.description: The application names to add to users specified in UserUids.

ReplaceExistingApplications.description: Whether applications already granted to users that aren't in ApplicationNames should be removed. Value: true if applications already granted to users that aren't in ApplicationNames should be removed; otherwise, false.

UserUids.description: The UIDs of the users to grant the applications provided in ApplicationNames.

UserApplicationSecurityRoleBulkChangePar.description:
A set of parameters for changing the security role of a specific application
across multiple users in a single operation.

AppID.description: The ID of the application whose security role should be changed.

SecurityRoleId.description: The ID of the security role to apply to each user for the specified application.

UserUids.description: The UIDs of the users whose security role for the specified application should be changed.

UserBulkChangeUsernameParameters.description: A set of parameters for changing the usernames of multiple users in a single operation.

Changes.description: The username changes to apply. Each entry maps a user UID to its new username.

UserBulkConvertToUserParameters.description: A set of parameters for converting multiple customers to full TeamDynamix users in a single operation.

Users.description: The customers to convert, along with the fields each requires to become a full user.

UserConvertToUserParameters.description:
Describes a single customer to convert to a full TeamDynamix user, along with the fields a
customer record doesn't already carry.

AuthenticationProviderID.description:
The ID of the authentication provider the converted user will use for authentication.

Remarks: Optional. If omitted, the organization's default authentication provider is used.

AuthenticationUserName.description: The authentication username of the converted user, used for authenticating with non-TeamDynamix authentication types.

Password.description:
The password to assign to the converted user.

Remarks: Required regardless of authentication provider.

PrimaryClientPortalApplicationID.description: The ID of the primary client portal application for the converted user. Value: The ID of the primary client portal application for the converted user, or null to use the organization default.

SecurityRoleID.description: The UID of the global security role to assign to the converted user.

UID.description: The UID of the customer to convert.

UserName.description: The TDX login username to assign to the converted user.

UserFunctionalRole.description: A relationship between a user and a functional role.

Comments.description: The comments of the associated functional role.

CostRate.description: The cost rate of the associated functional role.

CreatedDate.description: The date the user was associated with the functional role.

FunctionalRoleID.description: The ID of the associated functional role.

FunctionalRoleName.description: The name of the associated functional role.

ID.description: The ID of the user-functional role relationship.

IsPrimary.description: Whether the functional role is marked as the user's primary functional role. Value: true if the functional role is marked as the user's primary functional role; otherwise, false.

StandardRate.description: The standard bill rate of the associated functional role.

UID.description: The UID of the associated user.

IsManager.description: Whether the user is a manager of the group. Value: true if the user is a manager of the group; otherwise, false.

IsNotified.description: Whether the user is notified as a part of group notifications. Value: true if the is notified as a part of group notifications; otherwise, false.

IsPrimary.description: Whether the group is marked as the user's primary group. Value: true if the group is marked as the user's primary group; otherwise, false.

UserGroupsBulkManagementParameters.description:
A set of parameters designed to allow for setting the membership of
users in groups.

GroupIDs.description: The IDs of the groups to add to the users provided in UserUIDs.

RemoveOtherGroups.description: Whether groups already granted to users that aren't in GroupIDs should be removed. Value: true if groups already granted to users that aren't in GroupIDs should be removed; otherwise, false.

UserUIDs.description: The UIDs of the users to add the groups provided in GroupIDs.

UserListing.description: A subset of information about a user in TeamDynamix.

AlertEmail.description: The alert email address of the user, where system notifications are delivered.

AlternateEmail.description: The alternate email address of the user.

AlternateID.description: The alternate ID of the user.

AuthenticationUserName.description:
The authentication username of the user, used for authenticating with non-TeamDynamix authentication types. Value: The authentication username of the user.

Remarks: This value should be unique across all username and authentication usernames in your organization. If the provided value is not unique, it will be ignored. This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to an empty string.

DefaultAccountID.description: The ID of the default account/department associated with the user.

ExternalID.description: The organizational ID of the user.

FirstName.description: The first name of the user.

FullName.description: The full name of the user.

IsActive.description: The active status of the user. Value: true if the user is active; otherwise, false.

IsConfidential.description: The confidential status of the user. Value: Confidential users cannot be seen by unprivileged individuals within a client portal application.true if the user is confidential; otherwise, false.

IsEmployee.description:
The employee status of the user. Value: true if the user is an employee; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This only applies to Users. Customers will always have this set to false.

LastName.description: The last name of the user.

PrimaryEmail.description: The primary email address of the user.

ReferenceID.description: The integer ID of the user.

UserOrgApplicationsBulkManagementParamet.description:
A set of parameters designed to allow for setting the membership of
users in organizationally-defined applications.

OrgApplications.description: The applications to add to users specified in UserUids.

ReplaceExistingOrgApplications.description: Whether applications already granted to users that aren't in OrgApplications should be removed. Value: true if applications already granted to users that aren't in OrgApplications should be removed; otherwise, false.

UserUids.description: The UIDs of the users to grant the applications provided in OrgApplications.

UserSearch.description:
A set of filtering options used for searching
users.

AccountIDs.description:
The account IDs to filter on.

Remarks: When specified, only users who list the account as their default will be returned.

AlternateID.description: The alternate ID to filter on.

AppName.description: The name of the system-defined application to filter on.

AuthenticationUserName.description:
The authentication username to filter on.

Remarks: This performs an exact match on the user's authentication username. Since authentication usernames are unique per user, this will return at most one result.

ExternalID.description: The external ID to filter on.

IsActive.description: The active status to filter on. Defaults to true if not provided. Value: true if only active users should be returned, false if only inactive users should be returned; otherwise, null.

IsConfidential.description: The confidential status to filter on. Value: true if only confidential users should be returned, false if only unconfidential users should be returned; otherwise, null.

IsEmployee.description: The employee status to filter on. Value: true if only employees should be returned, false if only non-employees should be returned; otherwise, null.

MaxResults.description: The maximum number of results to return. Value: The maximum number of results to return, or null to return all matching items.

PhoneNumber.description: The phone number to filter on.

ReferenceIDs.description: The integer IDs to filter on.

SearchText.description:
The search text to perform LIKE-based filtering. Remarks: This will perform a LIKE search on the following columns:
  • Full name
  • Username (for TeamDynamix users)
  • External ID
  • Alternate ID

The maximum length of this is 50 characters.

SecurityRoleID.description:
The UID of the global security role to filter on. Value: The UID of the global security role to filter on, or null to not perform this filtering.

Remarks: When specified, only users who have this security role will be returned.

UserSummary.description: Summary information about a user in the TeamDynamix People database.

AlertEmail.description: The alert email address of the user where system notifications are delivered.

FirstName.description: The first name of the user.

FullName.description: The full name of the user.

LastName.description: The last name of the user.

ProfileImageFileName.description: The profile image file name of the user.

ReferenceID.description: The integer ID of the user.

UserType.description:
Describes the different types of users and customers tracked within TeamDynamix.

| Name | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| None | 0 | Indicates that the type of the user could not be determined. Should not be used in normal operations. |
| User | 1 | Indicates that the user is classified as a full TeamDynamix user. |
| Customer | 2 | Indicates that the user is classified as a customer, which means that they cannot log in to TeamDynamix. |
| Resource Placeholder | 8 | Indicates that the user is classified as a resource placeholder. These users act as a placeholder for actual users when planning out projects without knowing exactly who will be acting as the resource in question. |
| Service Account | 9 | Indicates that the user is classified as a service account. These users will be able to authenticate and use the API, but they will not be able to log in to TDNext, TDMobile, TDAdmin, or TDClient. |
x-enumDescriptions: Indicates that the type of the user could not be determined. Should not be used in normal operations.
Indicates that the user is classified as a full TeamDynamix user.
Indicates that the user is classified as a customer, which means that they cannot log in to TeamDynamix.

Indicates that the user is classified as a resource placeholder. These users act as a placeholder for actual users when planning out projects without knowing exactly who will be acting as the resource in question.
Indicates that the user is classified as a service account. These users will be able to authenticate and use the API, but they will not be able to log in to TDNext, TDMobile, TDAdmin, or TDClient.

UserUsernameChange.description: Maps a single user to their new username.

NewUsername.description: The new username to assign to the user.

ValidationMessage.description: A message indicating the results of a validation request.

MemberNames.description: The member names associated with the message.

Vendor.description:
A vendor.

Vendors represent manufacturers of products, suppliers of assets, providers of warranties and other service contracts, or any combination thereof.

AccountNumber.description: The account number of the vendor used to represent the organization.

AppID.description: The ID of the asset/CI application containing the vendor.

AppName.description: The name of the asset/CI application containing the vendor.

AssetsSuppliedCount.description: The number of assets supplied by this vendor. Value: This will be -1 if this total has not been loaded.

Attributes.description: The custom attributes associated with the vendor.

CompanyInformation.description: The contact information of the vendor's company.

ContactDepartment.description: The department of the primary contact associated with the vendor.

ContactEmail.description: The email address of the primary contact associated with the vendor.

ContactName.description: The name of the primary contact associated with the vendor.

ContactTitle.description: The title of the primary contact associated with the vendor.

ContractsCount.description: The number of contracts provided by this vendor. Value: This will be -1 if this total has not been loaded.

CreatedDate.description: The created date of the vendor.

CreatedFullName.description: The full name of the user who created the vendor.

CreatedUid.description: The UID of the user who created the vendor.

DroppedCustomAttributeIds.description:
The IDs of any custom attributes that were supplied on create, edit, or patch but could not be saved
because they do not exist for this vendor's application or are protected attributes that cannot be
written via the API. Only populated on create, edit, and patch responses; null on reads.

ID.description: The ID of the vendor.

IsActive.description: The active status of the vendor. Value: true if the vendor is active; otherwise, false.

IsContractProvider.description:
The contract provider status of the vendor. Value: true if the vendor is classified as a contract provider; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This flag is intended only for the purposes of quickly filtering down a list of vendors. It does not restrict whether a vendor can be listed as a contract provider or not.

IsManufacturer.description:
The manufacturer status of the vendor. Value: true if the vendor is classified as a manufacturer; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This flag is intended only for the purposes of quickly filtering down a list of vendors. It does not restrict whether a vendor can be listed as a manufacturer or not.

IsSupplier.description:
The supplier status of the vendor. Value: true if the vendor is classified as a supplier; otherwise, false.

Remarks: This flag is intended only for the purposes of quickly filtering down a list of vendors. It does not restrict whether a vendor can be listed as a supplier or not.

ModifiedDate.description: The last modified date of the vendor.

ModifiedFullName.description: The full name of the user who last modified the vendor.

ModifiedUid.description: The UID of the user who last modified the vendor.

Name.description: The name of the vendor.

PrimaryContactInformation.description: The contact information of the vendor's primary contact.

ProductModelsCount.description: The number of product models manufactured by this vendor. Value: This will be -1 if this total has not been loaded.

VendorSearch.description:
A set of filtering options used for searching
vendors.

CustomAttributes.description: The custom attributes to filter on.

IsActive.description: The active status to filter on. Value: true when only active vendors should be returned, false when only inactive vendors should be returned; otherwise, null.

NameLike.description: The text to perform a LIKE search on the vendor name.

OnlyContractProviders.description: Whether only vendors classified as contract providers should be returned. Value: true if only vendors who have been classified as contract providers should be returned; otherwise, false.

OnlyManufacturers.description: Whether only vendors classified as product manufacturers should be returned. Value: true if only vendors who have been classified as product manufacturers should be returned; otherwise, false.

OnlySuppliers.description: Whether only vendors classified as asset suppliers should be returned. Value: true if only vendors who have been classified as asset suppliers should be returned; otherwise, false.

SearchText.description:
The search text to filter on. When set, this will sort the results by their text relevancy.

Remarks: Text search incorporates the following elements:

  • Name
  • Description
  • Organizational account number
  • Primary contact name

WarningLinkProbeItem.description:
One item to resolve in a batch call to ProjectsController.ResolveWarningLinks (issue
218383) — a Budget Capacity Planner scenario-load warning whose project/request vanished
from the freshly-generated report, probed for whether it still exists and is visible.

AppId.description: The project application ID the item belongs to.

Id.description: The project or project request ID.

IsProject.description: True for a project/workspace, false for a project request.

WarningLinkTarget.description:
A confirmed-visible item resolved by ProjectsController.ResolveWarningLinks. Items that
don't exist or aren't visible to the caller are simply omitted from the response.

Id.description: The project or project request ID.

InternalTypeID.description:
Only set when IsProject is true — e.g. "Project", "ClosedProject",
"Workspace" — used by the SPA to pick the right nav URL shape.

IsProject.description: True for a project/workspace, false for a project request.

Name.description:
The item's current (live) name. The SPA uses this to replace the "#123" ID-only label
once the item is confirmed to still exist and be visible.

WorkflowAdvancement.description:
Describes the different ways in which a workflow progresses in response
to actions being taken on workflow steps.

| Name | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| None | 0 | An unknown or indeterminate value. |
| Approve | 1 | Indicates that the workflow is moving forward as the result of an approval or other affirmative action. |
| Reject | 2 | Indicates that the workflow is moving backward as the result of an rejection or other denial action. |
| Complete | 3 | Indicates that a workflow is advancing as the result of an item's completion. |
| Neutral | 4 | Indicates that the workflow is not being advanced. |
| Skip | 5 | Indicates that a workflow is advancing as the result of skipping an item. |
x-enumDescriptions: An unknown or indeterminate value.
Indicates that the workflow is moving forward as the result of an approval or other affirmative action.
Indicates that the workflow is moving backward as the result of an rejection or other denial action.
Indicates that a workflow is advancing as the result of an item's completion.
Indicates that the workflow is not being advanced.
Indicates that a workflow is advancing as the result of skipping an item.

WorkflowStatus.description:
Describes the different statuses that a workflow may have.

| Name | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| None | 0 | Indicates that the workflow has not completed or no specific decision was made on an item. |
| Approved | 1 | Indicates that the workflow as a whole was completed and the result was that the item was approved. |
| Rejected | 2 | Indicates that the workflow as a whole was completed and the result was that the item was rejected. |
x-enumDescriptions: Indicates that the workflow has not completed or no specific decision was made on an item.
Indicates that the workflow as a whole was completed and the result was that the item was approved.
Indicates that the workflow as a whole was completed and the result was that the item was rejected.

allOf.description:
A specialized workflow validation message that supports listing
the IDs of relevant steps in the workflow.

StepIDs.description: The UIDs of workflow steps associated with the validation message.

A workspace. Returned scoped to the calling user's own memberships, except for the
admin-service-account listing of every workspace in the organization.

ID.description: The workspace ID.

Name.description: The name of the workspace.

UserCount.description:
The number of active members on the workspace. This will be -1 if this total has
not been loaded (the all-workspaces admin-service-account listing does not populate it,
since neither the underlying project search nor its query provide a count cheaply).

AddedDate.description: The date the member was added to the workspace.

AlertEmail.description: The alert email address of the member.

FirstName.description: The first name of the member.

FullName.description: The full name of the member.

IsActive.description: Whether the member is active on the workspace.

IsAlternateManager.description: Whether the member is an alternate manager of the workspace.

IsPrimaryOwner.description: Whether the member is the primary owner of the workspace.

LastName.description: The last name of the member.

PrimaryEmail.description: The primary email address of the member.

ReferenceID.description: The integer reference ID of the member.

RoleID.description: The ID of the member's functional role on the workspace, if any.

RoleName.description: The name of the member's functional role on the workspace, if any.

WorkspaceMemberAddError.description: The reason a user could not be added to a workspace.

Error.description: The reason the user could not be added.

UID.description: The UID of the user that could not be added.

WorkspaceMemberAddResult.description: The result of adding one or more users to a workspace.

Failed.description: The users who could not be added, with the reason for each.

Succeeded.description: The UIDs of the users who were successfully added.

WorkspaceMemberRemovalMode.description:
Determines what happens to a removed workspace member's in-flight work.

| Name | Value | Description |
|------|-------|-------------|
| Delegate Materials | 0 | The removed member's work (files, schedules, etc.) is reassigned to the delegate. |
| Delete Materials | 1 | The removed member's created items are deleted; any remaining file/revision ownership is still reassigned to the delegate. |
